bio: The bistro at the exclusive Gut Lärchenhof golf club on the outskirts of Cologne offers a somewhat simpler alternative to the eponymous fine dining restaurant, but you are just as assured of flavour and freshness – at both lunch and dinner. They serve dishes ranging from Currywurst to Königsberger Klopse (meatballs) and caviar. Needless to say, the terrace overlooking the green is delightful!...
